ChIJxwK6seod2YgRlPe885Y1BhU.author: Adam R.

ChIJxwK6seod2YgRlPe885Y1BhU.author: Jared C.

ChIJxwK6seod2YgRlPe885Y1BhU.author: Scot H.

ChIJxwK6seod2YgRlPe885Y1BhU.author: Ramon C.

ChIJ33TXyw0g2YgR4lQNt5zx1zo.author: Alan S.
ChIJ33TXyw0g2YgR4lQNt5zx1zo.text: I knew where they were located, so I went on sunday. They were closed with a sign on the door that only said closed. I went back on monday.The same sign still said closed. I will never ever go back. Having had a sign shop, I know it's very cheap to put your hours on the front door. If they had their hours, like two other bike shops I went to did, I wouldn't have wasted two trips just to see a closed sign. I am guessing they have a big loyal Google following who look up everything on the internet before they do anything and don't need new people like myself, old and gray. I did look on google after I saw they were closed again for the second time. This proves what great reviews are worth. They have 4.8
ChIJ33TXyw0g2YgR4lQNt5zx1zo.reply:
Hi Alan,

We’re sorry for the inconvenience and frustration you experienced making two trips and finding us closed — we understand how that can be disappointing.

For clarity, our business hours are posted on both our website and on Google — the same platform used to leave this review.

That said, a 2-star review based solely on not being able to visit during business hours doesn’t reflect the quality of our work or the experience we provide once you’re here. We take a lot of pride in our service and the level of care we offer every customer.

If you’re open to giving us another try during posted hours, we’d be happy to assist you and show you what we’re about.

– Cyclevolution Team

ChIJDyfSQVbY3ogR9MBJbkOkdzE.author: Bob W.

ChIJDyfSQVbY3ogR9MBJbkOkdzE.author: John R.
ChIJDyfSQVbY3ogR9MBJbkOkdzE.text: Wonderful experience, they explained to me what I needed and why I needed it. Very sociable. I only needed a new tube and spoke wrap so the tech did it right away.  I will be bringing my bike in for a full tune up soon.

- Nina was a sweet addition to customer service!

ChIJDyfSQVbY3ogR9MBJbkOkdzE.author: JEAN F.

ChIJr2komuAp34gRWqiDwas6dQ4.text:

ChIJr2komuAp34gRWqiDwas6dQ4.author: Courtney N.
ChIJr2komuAp34gRWqiDwas6dQ4.text: It is great to see that we still have some local charm in Jupiter! Thank you guys for helping Bryce get his bike up and going today. He biked 4 miles at Riverbend after we left. We had a fun day and look forward to coming into your bike shop again soon. Thank you!

Courtney,

JeffO

ChIJr2komuAp34gRWqiDwas6dQ4.author: Manuel A.
ChIJr2komuAp34gRWqiDwas6dQ4.text:
Amazing store, amazing staff and amazing owner. Not sure where to begin but J-Town is by far one of the best bike stores in Florida. Customer service is second to none, staff is knowledgable and very down to earth, they do not pressure you on making a purchase rather help you in making the right decision. The store focuses more on customer service and just having a conversation with you than trying to sell you something. The store has a vast variety of accessories to chose from as well as bikes. Techs are fast and cordial and Jeff the owner is a great, understanding individual who truly cares about his business and his customers. I have read some of the negative reviews others have left and I truly do not understand why anyone will take their time to leave such hurtful comments based on lies.

I highly recommend this shop and its staff. They are always available, they are educated, they are professional and they treat you with the utmost respect. My brother, my sister in law and my wife have purchased bikes at J-Town as well as a handful of accessories and we are extremely happy with the service and the way the store does business. Pay them a visit, you will not be disappointed.
ChIJr2komuAp34gRWqiDwas6dQ4.reply:
Wow! Thanks so much for the amazing review.  We have so many customers in day in day out. Not many take the time to leave an amazing review like the one you did. That review is greatly appreciated, and I thank you taking the time to leave it.
Please if there's anything I can do to help you in the future let me know. Thanks again! Owner J-Town.

ChIJdY217TTY2IgR7063wp3ZIsk.author: Kim M.
ChIJdY217TTY2IgR7063wp3ZIsk.text: I always read reviews before visiting a business or store and I can say that every positive review about Mike, his customer service, his dedication to quality and attention to detail is spot on true and accurate! This is a great local business that everyone should definitely support. The one negative review that I saw posted on here was obviously fake and completely fabricated. I actually usually look for fake “good “ or “positive” reviews (as in the business pays a service or company to leave positive reviews), but before ever even walking in the door I could tell that not only were all of the positive reviews true and authentic, but the 1 negative review was completely fake and made up. Mike does a great job, is an honest businessman and does excellent quality work. I wish him all the success in the world.

ChIJdY217TTY2IgR7063wp3ZIsk.author: Paul S.
ChIJdY217TTY2IgR7063wp3ZIsk.text:

The owner was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and informative. He took the time to explain everything, answer my questions, and make sure I understood what my bike needed. You can tell he really knows bikes and takes pride in his work.

The service was excellent, the bike came out great, and the entire experience was easy and enjoyable. It’s refreshing to find a local bike shop where you get this level of personal attention and expertise.

I’ll definitely be bringing my bike back to Relentless Bicycles for future service. Highly recommended!

ChIJy39uOlt_3YgRE7DYNo9oxPw.author: Jason E.
ChIJy39uOlt_3YgRE7DYNo9oxPw.text:
I rented a road bike from Evolve Bike Shop during a two-week stay in the Walt Disney World area, and the experience was outstanding from start to finish.

Many cyclists are hesitant about renting a road bike around Orlando, but I found some fantastic riding throughout the area, including several rides through Celebration and on roads around Disney property. Having a reliable, high-quality bike made all the difference.

What really stood out was the level of service. Communication before my arrival was excellent, and the team made the entire process effortless. When I arrived at my resort, the bike was already there waiting for me, fully prepared and ready to ride.

The bike itself was in fantastic condition and clearly well maintained. Evolve didn't just provide the bike either. They included all the details that experienced cyclists appreciate: a Garmin mount, saddle bag, spare tubes, CO2 cartridges, pump, pedal wrench, and other essentials. It felt like a complete cycling setup rather than a simple rental.

The shop also offered to pick the bike up at the end of my rental, but I enjoyed riding it so much that I chose to ride back to the shop on my final day instead.

It's easy to see why Evolve has earned such a strong reputation among visiting cyclists. If you're traveling to the Disney World area and want a quality road bike rental backed by great service and attention to detail, I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them.

ChIJy39uOlt_3YgRE7DYNo9oxPw.author: Lisa K.
ChIJy39uOlt_3YgRE7DYNo9oxPw.text:
Before I left for my trip to Orange Lake Resort I scheduled a rental for 13 days to be
Delivered On day # 1 of my stay.   I spoke with an irritable man (not Roger the owner) and told him I wanted a cruiser bike to be delivered to my address at the Resort.    After several hours of waiting for the bike I called to see why the bike hadn’t been delivered.   I was told by that same  irritated man that it was not going to be delivered because I didn’t ask for it to be delivered.   I later learned than there was some other screen I was suppose to complete for the delivery.   Roger, the owner of the shop finally delivered the bike somewhere around 6 pm after he closed the shop.   So I lost a whole day of bike riding, as the bike wasn’t delivered until the evening after the shop closed.   The bike itself was wonderful and the Resort is a great place to ride.   Then I learned that my flight home changed and I was unable to use the bike on that 13th day.   I called Roger and told him I needed the bike to be picked up and he gave me a 1pm -2pm pickup time.   I had to hold
My party up from visiting Splash Lagoon as Roger didn’t arrive until 3pm ish.   I had hoped that Roger would grant me a credit to remedy the 2 days I was unable to ride.  No such credit was offered.   I’ll have to figure something out for my next stay.

ChIJ28eK2eVB24gRvB-zUGp-Dec.text: We bought two electric "e-bikes" from Pedigo Ft Myers in Nov of 2024, and then another in 2025. ChIJs_Af6yjCwogR1atSa20ZgkQ.author: Mark B.
ChIJs_Af6yjCwogR1atSa20ZgkQ.text: I recently purchased the Defiant Upgraded Controller Sine Wave 9 Pipe and L300 as and upgrade for my Jupiter Defiant E-bike. Tech service at Defiant is excellent. David has helped in the past with some of my other upgrades (Chopper kit, fenders) and he sent me wiring diagrams as well as the manual for the new screen. Installation went well and I have to say the new controller is a brilliant upgrade. There are a lot of wires, but the new controller wires match up perfectly with the old controller wires making for a smooth install. The torque delivery is well beyond the original controllers abilities. This helps me get up to speed quickly and gives the bike much better power to climb hills. The New screen is bright and responsive. Easy to read and make adjustments. Again a positive upgrade from the original screen. I have always been happy with the Defiant Bike and these upgrades just continue to keep me smiling. Love this bike.

ChIJs_Af6yjCwogR1atSa20ZgkQ.author: Meme K.

She was extremely pleasant & helpful. So glad that she called me. She even made it easy for me and sent me a link. Highly recommend Jupiter Bikes, great Electric Bikes!

ChIJs_Af6yjCwogR1atSa20ZgkQ.author: james c.

I received my Defiant Bike and I love it.  Megan at Jupiter was quick to answer all my emails and was very helpful.  It's a sharp looking bike and I get a lot of people asking me about it on the street . It runs great, super fast, it's light enough to carry, and is a lot of fun to ride.

Update 11/21/21 : This Defiant bike is really a trip to ride.  I had installed a new spring seat,  27.2 mm shock stem (& shim) and a  1 1/8" +30 deg front Shockstop... what a difference! Not only is the ride fast, enjoyable and efficient..  but it is now much more comfortable to ride.  I have discovered that the battery does get a slight recharge when going down hill ( over NYC bridges) and coasting... which is a feature that I did not think it had.  The weight of the bike with the new upgrades is just lightly below 60 lbs .. which is still great for me since I have to carry it up 2 flights of stairs.  Its a great bike!!
ChIJs_Af6yjCwogR1atSa20ZgkQ.reply: Thank you for your review! We are very responsive at Jupiter Bike and love that you and others are raving about the bike! Our bikes are light and portable making it the ultimate electric machine!

ChIJuYufEr3BkIgRy5yuMU9pois.author: Brooklyn W.
ChIJuYufEr3BkIgRy5yuMU9pois.text:
Bruce and the gang are super friendly and honest, and they will fix you up quickly! 10/10 highly recommend!

My OG Lectric XP Trike started throwing an error code, according to Lectric, it needed a new motor. I called Cycle Joint, which is listed as a Lectric Garage partner. Bruce had me bring my trike in so they could take a look, although, he did tell me that they didn't have a motor in stock. Bummer, but completely understandable! I brought it in yesterday, 12/20-2025 around noon.

Imagine my surprise, when at 6pm, he called and told me that it was, in fact, the motor that was bad. He asked me when I needed my beloved bike back. Knowing that they didn't have the motor in stock, I just said as soon as you can get it. He let me know that they DID end up having a motor in stock and they had already fixed it!! They even stayed open late so I could come and pick it up and helped me load it into the car!

Later I realized that I had missed a call from them at 4:15. So it really was within four hours that they had it diagnosed and fixed!! I will for sure be back to the shop!

I usually dont do reviews but, this bike shop is the exception  This is a great shop, knowledgable,  friendly no high pressure sales, great support after the sale. I took my bike up there around noon and he had the conversion done the next day!!!!!!!!!!. Took it for a test ride about an hour and there were no issues at all. The bike shifted perfectly in all gears. With the 10 speed system its easyer to reach top speed without spinning too much and there is no hill in my area that I cant easily go up. My bike rides like it came from the factory like that. I continue to be absolutly amazed at the support and honesty of this stores staff. This conversion went way smoother and faster tha I ever expected. If you need an EBIKE THIS IS THE BEST PLACE IN TOWN. I could go on praising this store, just buy from them, you wont be dissapointed.

ChIJofyjsnqx0YgRT5xj0elQJhw.author: Garry S.
ChIJofyjsnqx0YgRT5xj0elQJhw.text:
We recently visited Key West and had no intention of renting a car. Instead, we looked into renting bikes and discovered We Cycle—what a great find!

We rented pedal-assist bikes, and the price for a full 24-hour rental was very reasonable. We were staying at the entrance to Key West, more than two miles from downtown, but the owner took the time to give us clear directions and suggested the best route to ride. It turned out to be an absolutely beautiful ride. Along the way, you almost feel forced to stop and take in the scenery.

Once we got downtown, parking was incredibly easy. We would lock the bikes, walk a few blocks, come back on the other side of the street, and then ride further down to the next area. It made exploring the island simple and fun while always keeping our bikes close by.

We used the bikes for everything—going to stores, heading out to eat, and covering a lot of ground around the island.

Honestly, renting a car in Key West seems crazy after experiencing it this way.

The only downside is that you’ll come home wanting to buy one of the bikes! They rent high-end Gazelle bikes and they are an absolute blast to ride.

Thanks again, We Cycle. We’ll definitely see you again next year.

When we first looked at signing up, we noticed that understandably, that they required a minimum number of participants and no one had signed up yet. We decided that should we not be able to get on the Glow Ride, we'd rent bikes from Marathon Bikeworks during the day. Fortunately we looked later and they only needed 2 more. The first group canceled and Brandon and Madison did a personal tour just for us.

We hope to see you again when we do our Keys ride.

Brenda and George
Sugar Grove, IL

ChIJvz_QRRqt2YgR4FK1MItI1S4.author: Eco G.
ChIJvz_QRRqt2YgR4FK1MItI1S4.text:
After my recent knee surgery, my doctor recommended that I get an e-bike to help me stay active during my recovery. That's when I met Arnie at eBike Aventura.

From the very beginning, Arnie was incredibly helpful. He took the time to answer all my questions, helped me choose the right bike, professionally assembled it, and even delivered it to my home. A few days later, I noticed an issue with the brakes. I contacted Arnie, and without hesitation, he came out personally to inspect and adjust the bike.

That level of customer service is hard to find these days. It's refreshing to see a local small business that truly stands behind its products and genuinely cares about its customers, even after the sale.

If you're looking for an e-bike and want knowledgeable advice, honest service, and exceptional customer support, I highly recommend eBike Aventura. Thank you, Arnie, for making this such a great experience!

ChIJvz_QRRqt2YgR4FK1MItI1S4.author: Agustina C.
ChIJvz_QRRqt2YgR4FK1MItI1S4.text:
If this business was based on comunication and costumer service it would already collapsed... The man that runs it on Saturday morning was rude and cocky, I called to ask for service options and budget for my 3 bikes (2 super73 and 1 mini electric) and he had no intention to help or listen to my questions.
Don't waste your time, there are actually nice people willing to work and help in other near by bike shops.
ChIJvz_QRRqt2YgR4FK1MItI1S4.reply:
Hi Agustina,

I’m sorry you left with that impression, but it doesn’t reflect our conversation. At no point was I rude. I simply explained that I could not provide an accurate brake repair estimate over the phone.

During our conversation, you were unable to clearly explain what the issue with the brakes was. Without knowing whether the bike needed an adjustment, new brake pads, a brake bleed, or another repair, it would have been irresponsible for me to guess a price. I cannot give anyone an accurate estimate over the phone when the owner cannot clearly explain the problem.

That’s why I invited you to bring the bike to the shop so I could inspect it and provide an honest and accurate estimate. This is the same professional approach I take with every customer.

If your intention was simply to hurt my business with this review because I wouldn’t guess a repair estimate over the phone, that’s unfortunate. I will always choose honesty and accuracy over giving a price that may be completely wrong.

I stand by the way I handled our conversation and wish you the best.

Why ask me what i have if you dont work on it?thank you for wasting my time

Hi Lucian, 

we’re sorry you made the trip and were unable to get your Segway X260 serviced. However, we are an e-bike store and service center, not an e-motorcycle service shop. The Segway X260 is classified and designed as an electric motorcycle/off-road vehicle, and we do not service that type of vehicle.

We recommend contacting the website or dealer where you purchased your Segway X260. They should be able to provide you with an authorized dealer/service locator specifically for e-motorcycles.

We appreciate your understanding and wish you the best in getting your X260 serviced.

David 
Customer Service Manager

ChIJl426eCmy2YgR7JyvicWrR28.text:
I work hard for the things I own, so I was extremely upset to find your company’s sticker on my e-bike without my knowledge or consent.

Not only did someone put your promotional sticker on my bike, but they also removed one of my existing stickers to make room for it.

That’s completely unacceptable.

My e-bike has been in storage, so the only way this could have happened is because someone had access to it while it was being stored.

I don’t know who your employees are, and I never gave anyone permission to touch, alter, or advertise on my personal property.

Respect other people’s belongings!

Don’t remove items from someone’s property, and don’t place your promotional stickers on private property without the owner’s permission.

That’s not marketing, it’s vandalism and a complete disregard for other people’s property.

We're sorry to hear this. Our QR code sticker is placed on serviced bikes as part of our warranty process and also allows customers to quickly book service on the go. It is never our intention to remove or replace a customer's personal stickers without permission. Please contact us directly so we can look into this and remove the sticker for you.

Best Regards 

David 
Customer Service Manager

ChIJ8W-3X5e32YgROOkfIY2Av-o.text: Don’t bother shopping here. I try to support local when I can but they won’t help you because they want to protect their bottom line. I went in to try and exchange a $30 bike lock that I never used. I brought the receipt expecting a simple exchange and instead was met with a young man with an Afro and a middle  aged woman with black hair that told me they couldn’t help because it did not have the cardboard backing with the barcode on it. They refused, saying no one would buy it and it was their management that told them this rule and refused to help. I could have gone to any big box store and would have received better service and care. Unfortunately, I will never come back here again even though I was looking to get a bike fitting and considering their services even though it’s $250. I’m looking somewhere else!
ChIJ8W-3X5e32YgROOkfIY2Av-o.reply:
Hello Joe.

We’re sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations. We truly appreciate customers who choose to support local businesses, and we never want anyone to leave our store feeling that we did not value their business.

Our return and exchange policies are not intended to “protect our bottom line,” but to ensure that products returned to us are complete, in their original condition and packaging, and can be properly identified and resold as new. In this case, our team was following the store’s established policy regarding an item returned without its original packaging and barcode.

We understand that this was frustrating, and we regret that we were unable to provide the solution you were expecting. At the same time, we stand behind our team for following the policies they have been instructed to follow.

This experience is not representative of the level of customer service we strive to provide every day, as reflected in the many positive reviews and long-term relationships we have built with our customers.

We appreciate your feedback and are sorry that this experience has affected your decision to return. We hope you might consider giving us another opportunity in the future.

Fantastic local store owned by a wonderful couple named Lucie and Martin. Prices are very reasonable for the quality of product they sell.

The owners and their employees are super pleasant, helpful, knowledgeable, and also passionate about the products they sell.

I made the mistake of buying my son's first ebike off Amazon. The ebike that was delivered looked like the same as the photos, but the specs were way off. Battery, motor, etc were not even close to what was advertised. I managed to get half the cost refunded. Word of advice - don't buy an ebike online if you can help it. There are lots of shady sellers. That ebike is now a spare that my son's friends use when they are hanging out.

We purchased a QUALITY ebike from this establishment for a good price. Martin (the owner) had done a good bit of customization to the bike as well. My son absolutely loves it. I rode it home from their shop (~15 miles) and it was a super smooth/nice ride.

ChIJb9_XW--r4IgRNabveL-h_mg.author: George J.
ChIJb9_XW--r4IgRNabveL-h_mg.text: I would have given 5 stars but the owner had to hire some help because they are so busy, but the guy or guys they have doing the assembly of the bikes and accessories were very slow and took a very long time to install my fenders, hand guards, peddles, ECT. Also the back fender was cut and drilled and wasn't done right so the rear fender isn't bolted to the frame on the bottom front like it should be so its just flapping in the wind, the hand guards were loose, also the front fender was loose and needs adjusted a little, to many little things wrong for the amount of time it took to do the additional installation of parts. The rear fender was cut and drilled so off that im going to have to buy a new fender and install it myself. Other than that everyone was polite, professional, and had answers to all my questions. Prices are pretty good for the quality of bikes they offer. I highly recommend buying a e-bike from this place, just be prepared to wait a very long time to have any accessories or parts installed and check all of the work well before you leave the store.

Scott and the other worker were very kind and patient getting our bikes and familiarizing us with them. We had such a fabulous day. He did talk us all through the map and gave us ideas for routes. One thing I would suggest is to create a map with the routes and tips marked out better. We didn’t even realize until 3/4 of the way through our day that their suggested route is printed on the saddle bag but they didn’t point that out specifically. 🤦🏼‍♀️  For example, the print out and scott said to cruise the wood plank fishing bridge, which we did, and then to cross the big bridge in the bike lane. We were in the cement blockaded lane which we thought was correct but that stopped halfway across the bridge also and we had to turn around. You need to be on the actual road next to the cars in that small bike lane, not in the small lane separated by cement guard rail. Not a big deal but just minor details like that would be nice to have laid out in a map. It was also a little tricky to tell which was the best route to avoid busy streets if we wanted to do more than the main route they suggest, so having that on a map would be helpful. The bikes were great and batteries last a long time.

Highly recommend riding on the beach in the state park! It was almost empty and such a blast. It was not easy to get the bikes down or back through the soft sand but we took turns pushing from the back while the other walked it. If you stay where the sand is not too wet or dry it was great, but...

He has been competing since 2015, and his depth of knowledge, experience, and passion for the sport are obvious from the moment you start working with him.
Chris has helped me personally with selecting the perfect tri bike for my needs and then customizing it to fit me exactly. He has been extremely responsive, detail-oriented, and genuinely invested in helping me succeed. While we are waiting on a part for my optimal build, he set up my bike with a temporary configuration so I could keep riding and training in the meantime. When I had a minor mishap while learning the new bike, he worked me into his schedule right away and got the bike back in service immediately.
Beyond the bike itself, Chris has provided a wealth of advice for my own 70.3 Ironman training. Kim has also been in constant communication and helped connect me with the local triathlon community. Both Chris and Kim are consistently present at the twice-weekly tri swim training sessions at the Bernie R. Lefebvre Aquatic Center, which says a lot about how committed they are to supporting athletes in this area.
Playtri Fort Walton Beach is exactly what a great local small business...

Title: Paid $205 and $195 for parts, and my ebike still isn’t fixed!!

I had a very frustrating experience with Teked Mobile Bike Services.
I have a Sohoo e-bike that requires 20x4.0 tires (the same size that came on the bike).

I provided brand-new 20x4.0 tires, inner tube, and liners for $195.00 on Amazon, ordering it in front of the technician (he shared that when the item comes in, to call and drop off, which I did), expecting professional service to verify fitment before installation.

Instead, they installed the tires first and only afterward said they didn’t fit properly and were rubbing.

As the experts, you should have identified this before the work was done. They then installed the ordered tires, which are obviously not the correct size for my bike, and still charged about $205 total.

My bike was returned to me not properly fixed, and I now have to take it somewhere else to correct a basic tire replacement.

A professional service should:
Confirm compatibility before installing parts

Communicate clearly before proceeding.

Deliver a properly working result.

None of that happened here.
I’ve included photos showing the tire sizing and fitment issues.

BASED ON MY EXPERIENCE, I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND THIS PLACE NOR THEIR SERVICE.

See their invoice and bill I paid today for a bike I cannot ride, and photos attached.

To do this to an Army Veteran who is a widow is absurd. I asked him if he could sleep well at night knowing he didn't do a great job and didn't rectify...

I can’t say enough good things about E Cycle Adventures and the team there. After having a terrible experience with another bike shop where I originally purchased a bike, I went to the Velotric dealer locator and found them, that turned out to be one of the best decisions I could have made.

My first call was with Liz at the Brooksville store. She was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and took the time to understand what I was looking for before connecting me with Sean. From that point on, the entire experience was outstanding.

What really sets E Cycle Adventures apart is that Sean and Liz are the owners, and they’re in the store every day working directly with customers. You don’t find that very often anymore. They genuinely care about making sure you get the right bike, understand how it works, and feel supported long after the sale.

The experience was so good that I ended up buying not just one, but two Velotric bikes from them, a Nomad 2 and a Discover 3, interaction has been honest, professional, and completely focused on taking care of the customer rather than just making a sale.

If you’re anywhere in the Tampa Bay area and are considering an e-bike, do yourself a favor and make the drive to either of their 2 locations before buying anywhere else. Their customer service is second to none, their knowledge is outstanding, and it’s refreshing to support local independent business owners who truly stand behind what they sell.

Sean and Liz have earned my business for...

Thank you so much for your thoughtful and glowing review, John! We’re delighted to know that you’re loving your Velotric Nomad 2 and Discover 3, and we’re here for you anytime you need support. Thank you for recommending us so highly, and we look forward to seeing you again soon! Enjoy your new rides!

ChIJD8GVKA2NwogRSGUNahYqi2M.author: Joshua M.
ChIJD8GVKA2NwogRSGUNahYqi2M.text:
Tarpon Tom’s Bikes is the spot for all things cycling.

We had been in the market for e-bikes and spent a lot of time researching brands, reviews, and options online. A few weeks ago, while out and about on a Saturday, we decided to stop into the shop “just to look.” We were immediately greeted by Tom, who is honestly one of the most knowledgeable and well-rounded people I’ve met in the bike industry.

Tom quickly honed in on what would actually fit our lifestyle, explaining the pros, cons, and real-world differences between bikes without any pressure. It became pretty obvious, pretty quickly, that we wanted to buy from him and his team.

What makes Tarpon Tom’s different is that they are a rare breed of retail. They are relationship-driven. They aren’t just selling bikes, they’re building a community through honesty, education, and standing behind the products they carry.

We ended up purchasing both bikes that same day, and Tom’s team even stayed a few minutes after closing to make sure everything was perfectly adjusted, set up, and ready for us to ride. What really stood out that afternoon was how every customer who walked through the door felt like family to Tom and Yannie. After the sale, they even encouraged us to leave the truck parked there and take a ride around Tarpon Springs.

Fast forward three weeks later, and I noticed a slight rub on the front tire. I called Yannie, and he simply said, “Stop by when you have time.” It turned out to be nothing more than a quick...

I found this bike shop when over on vacation from Scotland in March.
As a keen cyclist I wandered in for a look around and try and find out if it was possible  to find any local bike clubs that might be having a weekend ride out whilst I was there, if possible hire a bike and tag along, to get away from the usual tourist stuff and see a bit of the real Florida.
There was a club run, so I hired a bike to go.
Gave Eddie all my measurements, who set everything up for me.
The day before the ride out I got a phone call saying " The club ride has been cancelled. You can still collect the bike and ride on your own or have a full refund, the choice is yours ".
Not having any local knowledge whatsoever i opted for the refund and left it there,disappointed but sometimes these things happen.
Not long after i received another phone call to say that Eddie would take me around a local route on his day off.
I jumped at the chance.
I turned up at 0700, the bike was there ready to go and away we went.
I can honestly say it was the best day I've ever had on a bike, the route was brilliant,roads decent, weather fantastic even the coffee shop we stopped at was great even though I had no idea where it was.
I can only speak from my experience, the guys were friendly, knowledgeable and went out of their way to make my day as memorable as possible.
If your on vacation and need to know anything,hire a bike even go on a club ride, this shop is the place to go.
The bike jersey is a great souvenir from...

I will not shop at this store again.Edited - Post Owner response. This is not true, the lady read back to me the wrong PH# - so you did not have the correct number. ChIJTf7Ik4AT54gRYEreqOb8KzY.reply:
It's unfortunate that you were disappointed with your experience. 

Our team called back twice using the phone number that was provided to us (we confirmed on our caller ID that it was correct) but unfortunately, there was no answer. In the meantime, another customer came into the store ready to purchase the bike and paid for it at that time.

Because our bikes are sold on a first-come, first-served basis, we’re unable to hold a bike without payment, particularly for someone who is not local and cannot immediately come into the store. 

We understand that this was frustrating and regret that the timing did not work out, but our team did make two attempts to return the call before the bike was sold.

I had been considering an electric bike for a couple of months. Then one day, I randomly met Dan at the beach while he was riding his electric bike. I asked him a bunch of questions, and it turns out he works at Big Cat Bikes, a bike store right around the corner from my house.

A few weeks later, I was researching bikes online and remembered Dan. When I Googled the store, I discovered they carried the same models I had been looking at online. The cool part is that unlike buying online, you can actually test ride the bikes at the store.

I felt a little like Goldilocks trying all the bikes to find my “just right.” Ironically, the bike I almost purchased online turned out to be the most uncomfortable one to ride!

Since I liked the folding bike I was considering, I decided to rent one first to see if I would feel comfortable using it for local errands. The rental bikes are larger and different models, so Jose generously allowed me to take the actual bike I was considering for an hour. I was even able to test whether it fit in my elevator — something I never would have known if I had ordered online.

By the time I returned, I knew I was purchasing the bike that day.

The entire staff was incredibly customer-focused. Jose never rushed me. He walked me through everything, taught me how to fold the bike, remove the battery, and answered all of my questions. They also installed accessories for me and did it all with kindness, patience, and great customer service.

That is...

The Trek Verve 3 with the low step was easy on, easy off, but was on the heavy side and difficult to get in and out of my vehicle.

Mike, the manager, used his experience and expertise to make every attempt to lighten the bike.  He removed a number of parts and replaced them with the lightest possible alternatives and better quality to suit my riding preferences. Ultimately, his solution took nearly 6 pounds of weight off of the bike. Not only is It much lighter, but it is much smoother and faster too.

The team at Trek Lakeshore has created the coolest Trek Verve 3 on the streets today. One of which I have already received many compliments, at a bargain price, and is custom made perfect for me!

ChIJjZSR_9Rl6IgRRXEQLjUnRR0.author: Mike
ChIJjZSR_9Rl6IgRRXEQLjUnRR0.text:
My truck is sitting at the Blue Run of Dunnellon Park today, and apparently one of these geniuses thought it was a smart idea to jam a thick paper flyer into the seal of my driver’s side window. It’s bad enough when a company takes the liberty of putting their trash under your windshield wiper, but to jam it into the seal of your window is absolutely the dumbest thing I’ve ever seen.

To make it worse, it poured rain while we were gone, so when I got back to my truck and tried to pull this thick flyer out of my window, it ripped in half, leaving part of the flyer stuck in the seal of my window and creating a space where water can now enter my door.

So here I am. I’m in my truck, it’s pouring rain, I can see the flyer stuck in my window seal but can’t get it out, and all I can think is that now the window can’t properly seal, and I’m sure water is dripping into my door. Can’t wait to see what that ends up damaging.

STOP TOUCHING OTHER PEOPLE’S THINGS. IT’S BAD MARKETING, AND IT MAKES PEOPLE ANGRY!!

The people were extremely nice, helpful and genuinely interested in getting us into what we needed and not what they wanted to sell. We did some test riding around the area and did not leave without it. They also set it up with a carrier for our dog. They also set us up with the Lectric factory online discount. My wife loves her trike and has put a few hundred miles on it.
A couple of weeks later, I had to upgrade too. I had researched online and thought a Rad, which I was already riding and wanted something bigger. I went back to the shop where they had the Rad I was looking for. I went in ready to buy it and as We discussed it and they told me that I might want to reconsider it as Rad was about to go bankrupt and did not know if they would survive, so parts might become an issue. This was news to me, they had the bike on the floor and chose to guide me away from it. This is an honest shop that is looking for your bike business. We discussed options and I tried a Himiway A7 that they had and after a ride I bought it and now have hundreds of miles and cannot say enough good things about it.
This shop and the folks that run it are the best!
